name: Push-up
steps: Start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower until your chest is just above the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Push back up without locking out harshly.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking up.
Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

name: Pull-up
steps: Hang from bar with palms facing away, shoulder-width apart.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
mistakes: Using momentum to swing up.
Not going to full extension at the bottom.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down as if into a chair.
Keep knees over toes, chest up.
Stand back up by driving through your heels.
mistakes: Knees caving inward.
Leaning too far forward.

name: Burpees
steps: Stand, then drop into a squat with hands on the floor.
Kick feet back into plank position.
Do one push-up.
Jump feet back to hands and leap straight up.
mistakes: Skipping the push-up.
Landing with locked knees.

name: Plank
steps: Get into a forearm plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and hold the position.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Letting hips sag toward the floor.
Holding your breath.

name: Walking Lunges
steps: Stand tall and step forward with one leg.
Lower hips until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Push off front foot and step forward with the other leg.
Keep torso upright throughout.
mistakes: Front knee going past the toes excessively.
Torso leaning forward.

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs in a running motion.
Keep hips level and core engaged.
mistakes: Bouncing hips up and down.
Going too fast with poor form.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at sides.
Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead.
Jump feet back together and lower arms.
Maintain a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Not fully extending arms overhead.
Landing with flat feet instead of balls of feet.

name: Dips (bench)
steps: Place hands on edge of a bench behind you.
Extend legs out in front, heels on the floor.
Lower body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to full arm extension.
mistakes: Flaring elbows outward.
Not going deep enough.

name: Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat.
Place hands behind your head lightly.
Curl shoulders off the floor using your abs.
Lower back down with control.
mistakes: Pulling on your neck with your hands.
Using momentum instead of abs.

name: Walking (brisk)
steps: Walk at a pace that elevates your heart rate.
Swing arms naturally at your sides.
Keep your posture upright and chin up.
Aim for about 100 steps per minute.
mistakes: Walking too slowly to get a benefit.
Looking down at the ground constantly.

name: Running (moderate)
steps: Start with a light jog to warm up.
Maintain a conversational pace for moderate runs.
Land midfoot with a slight forward lean.
Keep arms relaxed and swinging naturally.
mistakes: Starting too fast and burning out.
Over-striding with heel striking.

name: Cycling (moderate)
steps: Adjust seat height so legs are almost fully extended at the bottom.
Pedal at a steady moderate cadence.
Keep your core engaged and back neutral.
Shift gears to maintain consistent effort.
mistakes: Seat too high or low causing knee strain.
Gripping handlebars too tightly.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold rope handles at hip height with elbows close.
Swing rope with your wrists, not your arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
mistakes: Jumping too high.
Swinging from the shoulders instead of wrists.

name: Stair Climbing
steps: Find a staircase with at least 2 flights.
Walk or jog up at a steady pace.
Use the handrail for balance if needed.
Walk back down to recover.
mistakes: Skipping steps to go faster risking falls.
Leaning too far forward.

name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on the bench with feet on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with control.
Press the bar back up to lockout.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest.
Arching your back excessively.

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, barbell over mid-foot.
Hinge at hips and grip bar just outside knees.
Drive through heels, keeping bar close to body.
Stand tall and squeeze glutes at the top.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Pulling with the arms instead of driving with legs.

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Position bar across upper traps, step back from rack.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit down and back until thighs are parallel.
Drive up through heels to standing.
mistakes: Knees caving inward.
Not reaching parallel depth.
Excessive forward lean.

name: Overhead Press
steps: Hold bar at shoulder height with a grip just outside shoulders.
Brace core and press the bar straight overhead.
Lock out arms fully at the top.
Lower bar back to shoulder height with control.
mistakes: Leaning back too much to cheat the weight up.
Pressing the bar forward instead of straight up.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit at the machine with thighs secured under pads.
Grip the bar wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar down to upper chest level.
Squeeze shoulder blades together, then release slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Using body momentum to swing the weight.

name: Rowing Machine
steps: Sit on the rower and strap feet in securely.
Push with legs first, then lean back and pull handle to chest.
Reverse the motion: extend arms, lean forward, bend knees.
Maintain a smooth and controlled rhythm.
mistakes: Pulling with arms before legs extend.
Hunching the back during the pull.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly back down.
mistakes: Swinging the weights using body momentum.
Not fully extending at the bottom.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable machine, grip the bar or rope.
Keep elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the handle down until arms are fully extended.
Return slowly to the starting position.
mistakes: Moving elbows away from your sides.
Using too much weight and swinging.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform toward you.
Push the platform away by extending your legs.
Do not lock knees fully at the top.
mistakes: Placing feet too high or low on the platform.
Letting knees cave inward.

name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with elbow under your shoulder.
Lift hips off the ground forming a straight line.
Hold position while engaging obliques.
Keep neck neutral and breathe steadily.
mistakes: Letting hips drop toward the floor.
Rotating the torso forward or backward.

name: Box Jump
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform.
Bend knees and swing arms back.
Jump explosively onto the box landing softly.
Step back down rather than jumping down.
mistakes: Landing with straight legs on the box.
Using a box that is too high before ready.

name: Swimming (moderate)
steps: Enter the pool and push off the wall.
Use a steady freestyle stroke at moderate effort.
Breathe every 2-3 strokes on alternating sides.
Complete laps at a consistent pace.
mistakes: Lifting head too high to breathe.
Kicking from the knees instead of hips.

name: HIIT Circuit
steps: Choose 4-5 exercises like burpees, squats, push-ups.
Do each for 30 seconds at max effort.
Rest 15 seconds between exercises.
Complete 3-4 rounds total.
mistakes: Sacrificing form for speed.
Not resting enough between rounds.

name: Treadmill Running
steps: Set the treadmill to a comfortable jogging speed.
Gradually increase speed after warming up.
Maintain upright posture and natural arm swing.
Cool down by walking for 3-5 minutes.
mistakes: Holding onto the handrails while running.
Starting at too high a speed.

name: Elliptical Trainer
steps: Step onto the machine and grip the handles.
Push and pull handles while pedaling smoothly.
Keep posture upright and core engaged.
Adjust resistance for desired intensity.
mistakes: Leaning heavily on the handles.
Setting resistance too low for any benefit.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, kettlebell between feet.
Hinge at hips and grip the kettlebell with both hands.
Swing it back between legs then thrust hips forward.
Let the kettlebell float to chest height, arms straight.
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging at the hips.
Using arms to lift instead of hip drive.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep back flat against the wall.
Hold the position for time.
mistakes: Letting knees go past your toes.
Placing hands on your thighs for support.

name: Skipping (outdoor)
steps: Hold rope handles at hip height.
Swing rope overhead and jump as it passes under feet.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady consistent rhythm.
mistakes: Jumping too high off the ground.
Tensing up shoulders instead of staying relaxed.
